threats.point: Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 26 -> 72 Cr (TTM) but operating cash flow 12 Cr (Mar 2025) -> 4 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Receivables are stretching year on year.
A premium multiple versus peers can unwind quickly if growth slips.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The CPC industry faced heavy reliance on imports such as low-sulphur RPC from the U.S. and other Europe and Asian countries affecting cost and availability.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Heavy reliance on imports (esp. low-sulphur RPC from the U.S. and Other Europe and Asian countries) affects cost and availability." (concall ppt - 2025-05-01)

threats.point: Energy-intensive calcination process raises operational costs especially during power and fuel inflation.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Energy-intensive calcination process raises operational costs, especially during power/fuel inflation." (concall ppt - 2025-05-01)

threats.point: Trade restrictions and anti-dumping duties or export/import restrictions in key markets impact pricing.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Anti-dumping duties or export/import restrictions in key markets (e.g., China, USA and West Asia Market) impact pricing." (concall ppt - 2025-05-01)
